title: wb migrate reports a snapshot count that does not match the snapshot files it leaves, so a carrier checking its dropped units were kept cannot read the line
body:
`intent wb migrate`'s closing line reports `N snapshot(s)`, and on two estates that number did not match the snapshot files the carry left on disk.

**Seen, on the Intent 3.2.0 pair (4e2f908a5), 2026-09-21:**

| estate   | node | reported       | files under `.history/pre-migration/` |
| -------- | ---- | -------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| arca_cli | cc   | 3 snapshot(s)  | 1                                     |
| arca_cli | vc   | 3 snapshot(s)  | 1                                     |
| Conflab  | cc   | 27 snapshot(s) | 4                                     |
| Conflab  | dc   | 10 snapshot(s) | 3                                     |
| Conflab  | ic   | 21 snapshot(s) | 4                                     |
| Conflab  | vc   | 29 snapshot(s) | 1                                     |

The carries themselves are sound. Every unit dropped on `--drop-uncarried` is present in a pre-migration file, checked by byte comparison against a copy of each board taken before the carry. So nothing is missing. The number is what does not match. The carries are Conflab a0fc931c and arca_cli c99e21c.

**Expected:** a report line's number counts what its label names, or the label says what it counts. Whoever reads `3 snapshot(s)` beside one snapshot file cannot tell whether two are missing or the number counts something else. A carrier checking that its dropped units were kept reads this line to decide.

The ask is the report line only. What the number counts today is not established here.

---

**CLOSED ON THE LANDING AT 4f5513f99 (dc, 2026-09-21), patch-id d04074fe2, identical to the bank vc judged from refs/bank/dc/0499/patch.**

**What the number counts, measured.** `WbMigration::snapshots` holds every `.history/**/*.md` document the carry took into the store (`read_snapshots`). That is the node's fold archives plus the pre-migration copies this carry keeps. On both estates it matches disk exactly: Conflab's cc, dc, ic and vc have 27, 10, 21 and 29 such documents, of which 4, 3, 4 and 1 are pre-migration copies; arca_cli's cc and vc have 3 each, of which 1 each. So the count was right for what it counts, and it is a term in AC-14.9's `reconciles()`. The label was the defect: `snapshot(s)` is also what the refusal's remedy calls the pre-migration copies.

**The fix, as landed.**
- The closing line reads `N .history document(s) carried`, and the count is unchanged.
- `WbMigration` gains `kept`: the pre-migration copies the carry keeps, sorted.
- The report names each on its own line: `kept: <path> -- the file as the carry read it, byte for byte`. A dropped unit is in one of those files and nowhere else, so that is where a carrier checks.

**A premise corrected on the way, in dc's words.** The plan said a copy is kept only when something is dropped, and that was false. Per 0438's rule the carry keeps the board whole every time, and keeps an inbox only when it holds a unit the model cannot carry. arca_cli's cc showed it first: a whole carry left one copy. The arm's own negative control caught it before the bank, and the `kept:` line's wording, its doc and the CHANGELOG line were corrected to say what is true of every copy.

**The arm**, `intent-cli/tests/wb_migrate_names_its_kept_copies.rs`, runs through the binary.
- dc: a board with a lead paragraph, an inbox with a hand-written note and one `.history/20260801/wip.md` archive, migrated with `--drop-uncarried`. It reads `3 .history document(s) carried` and no `snapshot(s)`. It names exactly the two copies, in path order, each byte-equal to its source, and does not name the archive.
- The negative control is vc, whose inbox carries entry by entry: one `kept:` line (its board), no inbox copy on disk, and `1 .history document(s) carried`.
- It is red at :85 with the render reverted.

**The runs**, in a private worktree at d662628c0 (in-tree target, isolated HOME), 16:56:49Z to 17:01:43Z. The load was 56 at the start, 115 after intentsvcs and 308 after intent-cli.
- intentsvcs: 1824 passed, 0 failed.
- intent-cli: 1045 passed, 0 failed.
- clippy `-D warnings` clean; rustfmt 2024 clean.
- The install pointer read back after as the dev tree.
